name: ALM Sports Summer Camp Swansea
description_short: A weekday summer day camp for boys and girls aged 5-15, run by ALM Sports at the Get Air Trampoline Park in Swansea, MA. Days include jumping sessions, enrichment, sports and weekly field trips, with full-day (8am-6pm) and half-day options.
refund_policy_summary: All fees are non-refundable unless ALM does not provide the service. There is a one-time $50 family registration fee, which is also non-refundable.
special_needs_notes: Page says the camp is for "All Abilities". It gives no details on what support is available.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming / splash pad is offered every week and is optional. The page doesn't say where it happens or how it is supervised.
